title: Pixel Consistent Slimes x Fresh Animations
description: Fixes magma cube's eyes for fresh animations
body: Mojang recently made sulfur cube pixel consistent but didn't change other slimes so I fixed it. I took the textures from faithful x32 and x 64. You need ETF or Optifine for it to work. Credit: https://faithfulpack.net/    . This is the version with magma cube's eyes fixed for Fresh Animations. Regular slimes actually work with the regular version of my resoursepack
